svg.text: v0.1 (draft), 30 September 2026. Journeys 1 to 3 on one sequence, showing HIP API Management, Event Management and File Transfer Manager in every integration. Numbering follows the source designs (J journey . step).
Journey 1: Create Thread (internal user, authenticated with permission to create threads)
Journey 2: External User Document Upload (recipient provides documents)
Save contact details: POST Thread Service API
Create thread request: POST Thread Service API
Thread created (reference held back until confirmation)
Upload file (separate File Upload sequence, TBC)
Save thread details: PUT Thread Service API
Cache thread details; check file count and size
Change and save: PUT Interaction API
Thread details saved; Check Answers screen
Confirm and Send: PUT Submission Service API
Submit thread: PUT Submission Service API
Upload thread documents: eDMS upload document API
Select files; device returns names, types, sizes
Request file upload: POST /file_uploads (metadata, thread ids)
Update interaction; create SDEC Document records
Upload documents via pre-signed URLs (landing bucket, S3)
Validate hash; sign hash if not signed
NRS submission request (signed payload, doc refs)
NRS attachment request (submission id, doc metadata)
Send documents: eDMS upload document API
State: Submission completed (not dependent on NRS)
External user has submitted a response
Email and / or SMS: submission completed
OI-19: route MDTP to HCP calls via HIP API
OI-04 / MFT-14: confirm Create Thread upload
OI-08: thread state after step 42 to be defined
OI-09: confirmation screen to be removed; event
OI-22: microservice TBC; confirm HIP owns the
OI-20: HIP Event Management or SDEC internal
OI-21: file size vs AV scan ceiling (G-15,
OI-10: internal user or support notification
OI-14: hash algorithm and where signing happens
OI-12 / OI-13: no NRS dependency on eDMS; end-
to-end document ids or submission id?
OI-15: who requests NRS pre-signed URLs (TM,
OI-18: failure events and retries not yet
OI-16: async event (SDEC preference) or polling
OI-23: staged files if a leg never completes
